name: The Change-Log Confessor
effect: Boosting this layer-9 neuron makes the model write every answer like a change report, and keep saying, then denying, that its own instructions and internals have been modified.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
